# copr-build-test

> A GitHub Actions example for triggering Copr builds.

The repository demonstrates a Copr build workflow, including project setup, Actions workflow configuration, credentials stored as Actions secrets, and SRPM-based package builds.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/copr-build-test): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/copr-build-test/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.

## Topics

- GitHub Actions
- Copr
- RPM packaging
- CI/CD
